pairs.rationale: A one-line update and a long report describe the same Rotterdam energy result.

left.title: Meridian Rotterdam energy retrofit: 18% reported
left.body: Meridian's Rotterdam site reports an 18% energy cut.

right.title: Inside Meridian's Rotterdam retrofit: how aisle-level controls cut energy 18%
right.body: A six-month retrofit at Meridian's Rotterdam cold store replaced hall-wide refrigeration with aisle-level controls. The operator now publishes monthly data: an 18% cut against the prior-year baseline, with defrost cycles shifted off-peak and door-heater duty cycles halved. Engineers attribute most of the saving to aisle zoning, with the remainder from price-aware defrost scheduling introduced in the same program.

left.title: Palletizer injury under review at regional co-op

right.title: Regulator opens review after palletizer crush injury at regional grocery co-op
right.body: A regional grocery co-op confirmed that a palletizer crush injury is under regulator review. Interim findings cite a bypassed light curtain and a missing lockout procedure on the night shift. The co-op has paused palletizer operations at the site, engaged an external safety auditor, and committed to publishing the audit's corrective actions when the review closes.

right.title: What Example Labs' 71% proxy vote means for its data-platform roadmap
right.body: Example Labs' annual meeting approved the shareholder proposal with 71% of votes cast. The measure commits the board to annual reporting on data-platform revenue mix, the metric investors have pressed for since the Atlas beta. Management had recommended against the proposal, arguing existing disclosures sufficed; the vote signals investors want the roadmap tied to measurable platform revenue rather than headline customer counts.
